== Summary ==
[[1998 Decipher World Championship]], Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia, 20–22 November 1998. Scrapbook page: finalists playing in front of the Star Wars wall with play projected for spectators, and the Sunday sealed-deck event for spectators. From the Hunter family photo album.

== Source ==
Photographed album page posted by [[Hayes Hunter]] in the Players Committee Slack, 7 April 2020 ("My mom is downsizing. Pictures (and captions) from Worlds 1998 and MA states 2000"): https://starwarsccg.slack.com/archives/C4BHV1KTK/p1586279248461000
